name: EditDocument
caption: Edit XML/JSON Document

configuration.description: The document format, exact and case-sensitive; anything but "JSON" counts as "XML". Not detected from the content. Decides the path language: XPath for XML, JSONPath for JSON.

The XML or JSON TEXT to edit, normally a SmartField such as {{trigger_Xml}} (e-invoice trigger), {{Http_body}} or a flow element {{xml}}. Never a record reference: {{trigger_Document}} is the posted invoice as a record and fails the step with "not well-formed XML".

At least one row. Rows: { "op": "set"|"insert"|"delete", "path": "<XPath or JSONPath>", "position": "last"|"first"|"before"|"after", "value": "<text or fragment>" }. value is SmartText and required for set and insert; position is read for insert only (default last). Every element the path matches is changed. A set whose path matches nothing CREATES the element/attribute (absolute plain path, missing parents included, as last child; XML: a new element needs a declared prefix unless its parent has no namespace; JSON: object members only, as text); insert/delete without a match are logged and skipped. SmartFields work inside path too.

Optional: exactly one flow element placeholder {{name}} (an element created by Create Element, value type). The edited document is written into that element in addition to the document output, so a later step - or the next iteration of a ForEachLoop step - reads the edited version through {{name}}. A dotted path or plain text is rejected at publish.

rules.message: Enter the document to edit, normally a SmartField ({{...}}) carrying XML or JSON from an earlier step, for example {{trigger_Xml}}.

rules.check: configuration.operations must contain at least one row
every row's op must be set, insert or delete
rules.message: Change %1: pick Set value, Insert or Delete.

rules.check: every row's path must be non-empty
rules.message: Change %1: enter the path of the element to change.

rules.check: rows with op set or insert must have a non-empty value
rules.message: Change %1: enter the value to set or the content to insert.

rules.check: configuration.resultElement, when set, must be a single {{name}} placeholder without a dot
rules.message: Save result to: pick one flow element ({{name}}) or leave the field empty.

rules.check: the document must parse in the chosen format; a fragment to insert must parse too. The message shows the first 120 characters of what the step received

rules.check: an insert or delete whose path matches nothing is skipped and logged, the document is unchanged
rules.message: No element matches the path %1 - change %2 (%3) skipped.

rules.check: a set whose path matches nothing creates the element (XML: absolute path of plain steps, prefix required under a namespaced parent; JSON: dotted object path) and logs it; when it cannot be created the row is skipped with the reason

notes: No edges, no modes: the step is the list of changes. Repeating elements are handled by a path that matches all of them (//cac:InvoiceLine/cbc:Note), or by looping over Business Central records with the ordinary ForEachLoop step and keeping the document in a flow element (see the page).

XML paths use the Parser's namespace handling: declared prefixes work as they are, an unprefixed step is rewritten to *[local-name()='…']. Predicates with SmartFields are the way to address one line: //cac:InvoiceLine[cbc:ID='{{Line_currentItem.Line No.}}'].

Set creates: `/Invoice/cbc:BuyerReference` on a document without BuyerReference adds `<cbc:BuyerReference>` as the LAST child of Invoice. UBL/CII order matters under schema validation, so for a new header element prefer insert with position before/after a known sibling; use set-create for elements whose position is free or inside a freshly created parent. `//x`, predicates, wildcards and unprefixed names under a namespaced parent are not created (reason logged).
A set on an XML element replaces its whole content, child elements included.
In the e-invoice XML of XRechnung and PEPPOL the line's cbc:ID is the posted line's Line No.
Typical use: inside a "When an e-invoice is created" flow of AutoFlow E-Document for Germany, between the trigger's Xml output and the Return e-invoice XML step.
